title: configure nextcloud-mcp-server settings
description: Configure the Nextcloud MCP server, its Traefik route, and the external Ollama embedding endpoint.

host.description: Traefik host name for the MCP endpoint, like 'mcp.example.com'

lets_encrypt.title: Let's Encrypt certificate
lets_encrypt.description: Request a valid Let's Encrypt certificate.

http2https.title: HTTP to HTTPS redirection
http2https.description: Redirect all the HTTP requests to HTTPS

nextcloud_host.description: Nextcloud base URL, without a trailing slash

nextcloud_username.description: Nextcloud user name used by the MCP server

nextcloud_password.description: Nextcloud app password (Settings, Security, Devices and sessions). Not the login password.

ollama_base_url.description: Base URL of an external Ollama server, for example http://pc01:11434

ollama_embedding_model.description: Ollama embedding model name. The model must already be pulled on that host.

enable_semantic_search.description: Enable Qdrant semantic search. Default is true. When true, ollama_base_url is required by the module validator.
